description: Wait until someone presses a physical wall button / input and report which one it was: input id, name, kind of press and what the input is bound to. Use it to identify inputs during setup: ask the user to press one button, then call this. Returns at the first press, or after timeout_s (default 30, max 60) saying nothing was pressed - call it again to keep waiting. A press made up to 4 s before the call still counts. count > 1 collects several presses in one call. Firmware 4.27+ reports every gesture (short press, long press, release), so a short tap is enough; older firmware only shows the momentary state, so the button must be HELD for 2-3 s. Disabled inputs and inputs the account has no permission for report nothing. Changes nothing on the controller.

count.description: how many presses to collect before returning (default 1)

name: myio_wait_input
title: Wait for a button press
